mutations.label: QJ1 THE TICKET: the quotes are stripped before the keyword test again, so a column named `unique` reads as a table-level clause and vanishes from sql_tables -- 690 of the 988 'missing registered columns' errors in the gate ledger (r171 358, r183 294), 124 of them on rows that PASSED, telling the lane to add a column the DDL already had
QJ2 the skip list is dropped entirely, so `UNIQUE (email, tenant_id)` becomes a column called `unique` on every spine table -- the opposite error, and the reason the skip list exists
QJ3 the quote test is inverted, so quoted columns are skipped and unquoted clauses are kept -- both halves wrong at once, which a test asserting only one direction would miss
